run_vqa_inference: run visual question answering inference on an image with a question using VisualQuestionAnsweringInferencer
list_vqa_models: list all available visual question answering model names using VisualQuestionAnsweringInferencer.list_models
visualize_vqa_results: visualize visual question answering predictions with optional show and save directory parameters
preprocess_vqa_inputs: preprocess image and question inputs for batched visual question answering inference
postprocess_vqa_preds: postprocess visual question answering predictions into question and answer dictionaries
